name: Edward Saatchi
bio: British entrepreneur and filmmaker; co-founder of Oculus Story Studio and, in 2018, Fable Studio, where he leads the AI Showrunner platform for generating animated TV episodes.
bioMore: Co-directed the sci-fi short "One" with Ricardo Villavicencio, which placed third at Runway's AI Film Festival (AIFF) 2025. That short is not yet in this catalog.
